howItWorks.subtitle: Operational Flow
howItWorks.title: How WorkPilot Orchestrates Tasks
howItWorks.description: Go from incident or inbound request to automated resolution in three secure steps.

step1.title: Configure Triggers
step1.description: Connect inputs like Gmail, Webhooks, Slack channels, or production CI/CD servers. Set rules defining when WorkPilot should intervene.

step2.title: Agent Context Parsing (RAG)
step2.description: WorkPilot agent spins up, references internal guidelines via semantic vector search, checks logs, and drafts an optimal resolution path.

step3.title: Audited Action Execution
step3.description: The bot executes the command inside a secure sandbox. The human manager is notified and has a 60-minute undo safety window.
